title: Chinna Muthu
desc: Chinna Muthu, a valiant young man, opposes the atrocities of rich landlords in his village. His life turns upside down when his sister is impregnated by Sevatha Pandi, a wealthy man.

title: Thai Mozhi
desc: Rajasimham, a local criminal, falls in love with a woman. However, his wealthy, long-standing enemy, Mariadas, tries his best to disrupt Rajasimham's life.

title: En Rathathin Rathame
desc: A poor man who houses and feeds orphaned children acquires the power to go invisible at will. He decides to put this power to good use by trying to make the society around him a better place to live.

title: Doss
desc: Rajeshwari and Antony, a young couple, have major class differences. She decides to elope after her father kills her sister for marrying a man from a lower caste.
